turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I hit snooze like six times every morning and still wake up groggy.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Snoozing actually makes the grogginess worse. Want to try one alarm with no snooze allowed, or a sunrise alarm light that wakes you gradually?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, I need a minute with my roommate. Just stay silent until I come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you see? School's closed. Snow day.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The kids are going to be unbearable. In a good way.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we take them sledging on the big hill after lunch?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Only if someone shovels the drive first. I can't get the car out.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: They'll throw snow at each other for ten minutes and then demand hot chocolate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's still ten minutes of shovelling.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine. Kids on shovel duty, then sledging, then hot chocolate. Deal.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, waking up less groggy. Which option?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The sunrise light. Being yanked awake is the worst.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice choice. Set it for about half an hour before your actual alarm time.
